candidate_083.name: solution-withholding Socratic causal critic before intervention
candidate_083.mechanism_hypothesis: Separate proposal from critique by constraining the critic to causal questions, physical-constraint checks, counterexamples and falsification criteria rather than letting it provide a competing solution. Require the proposing scientist to repair its own causal chain before an experiment is promoted, so critique can expose hidden assumptions without becoming an uncontrolled second planner.

primary_evidence.source: Xianrui Zeng et al., Socratic agents for autonomous scientific discovery in high-dimensional physical systems, arXiv:2606.26722v1, 2026-06-25.
primary_evidence.physical_scope: The reported AHOIS system operates a real multimode-fibre optical platform with complex wave transformations, indirect detection, environmental drift and multimodal acquisition. The paper reports a five-agent scientist architecture in which a physics critic conducts Socratic interrogation of candidate hypotheses and experiment plans.
primary_evidence.reported_outcomes: The system reports discovery of a random-interference encoding regime with effective rank 56.9 and downstream image-classification performance of 76.97% on MNIST and 83.17% on Fashion-MNIST, plus an adaptive sparse-scanning strategy on the physical platform. The paper also reports ablations in which Socratic interrogation improves physical consistency, hypothesis completeness, uncertainty calibration and experimental-plan validity relative to weaker critic variants.
primary_evidence.control_relevance: This supplies physical-science evidence for keeping critique causally interrogative and solution-withholding before promotion. It suggests a safer precursor to mandatory repair: force the primary proposer to answer explicit causal and falsification challenges rather than accepting a critic-authored replacement plan.
primary_evidence.limits: The strongest quantitative ablations concern reasoning/plan quality rather than a randomized live-laboratory comparison of discovery yield. Human oversight remains part of the physical workflow, and detailed critic-turn utility breakdowns are not treated here as primary evidence.

candidate_084.name: failure-mode-typed self-correction and context/tool admission
candidate_084.mechanism_hypothesis: Diagnose the defect class before invoking repair. Route procedural/constraint defects to criterion-by-criterion mandatory checks, route numerical/reasoning defects to holistic re-analysis, validate tool arguments before execution, and admit retrieval context only when it has positive expected marginal value for the unresolved defect.

primary_evidence.source: Gihan Panapitiya et al., AutoLabs: cognitive multi-agent systems with self-correction for autonomous chemical experimentation, Scientific Reports 16, 19554 (2026), published 2026-06-25.
primary_evidence.matched_design: AutoLabs evaluates 20 architecture configurations across five chemistry benchmark experiments, with 10 executions per configuration, systematically varying reasoning, multi-agent structure, tools and self-checking style.
primary_evidence.typed_repair_result: Guided self-checks using specialized sequential criteria significantly improve procedural correctness/F1, whereas unguided holistic self-checks are more effective for numerical chemical-quantity errors: baseline-relative nRMSE falls by 37% for the non-reasoning single-agent configuration and by more than 50% for the other tested configurations. The same unguided check can reduce procedural F1 by adding extraneous steps, showing that a single generic reflection operator is not uniformly beneficial.
primary_evidence.tool_and_retrieval_boundary: The study documents tool failure when an under-specified reagent argument is passed to a calculator, and it reports that retrieval augmentation can improve weaker configurations but degrade an already guided/tool-using configuration. These are direct reasons to validate tool arguments and gate retrieval by task-local need rather than making either channel always-on.
primary_evidence.control_relevance: The evidence supports a deterministic failure-mode router before repair: structured constraint checks for procedural defects, deeper holistic reasoning for quantitative defects, and explicit admission gates for tool calls and retrieval context.
primary_evidence.limits: The benchmark focuses on chemistry protocol generation and execution-readiness rather than open-ended scientific discovery yield. It does not isolate an evidence-changing-repair requirement as a standalone randomized component.

candidate_085.name: externalized reversible epistemic state as the exploration-control interface
candidate_085.mechanism_hypothesis: Represent each scientific claim with explicit evidence identity, counter-evidence, calibrated status and remaining uncertainty, then let those reversible epistemic fields control whether the agent deepens, switches, retires or branches. Treat claim state as a control surface rather than passive narrative memory.

primary_evidence.source: Jiayao Chen, Shi Liu, Linyi Yang, StatefulDiscovery: Evidence-Calibrated Claim Formation in Open-Ended Scientific Discovery, arXiv:2606.11851v1, 2026-06-10, plus the authors' public implementation repository SUSTech-GenAI/StatefulDiscovery.
primary_evidence.implementation_evidence: The official evidence-strength judge verifies raw numbers and methods, adjudicates main claims against alternatives/artifact/robustness checks, records evidence references, supports supported/weakened/refuted/inconclusive claim states and caps confidence when red flags exist. Investigation state separately records supporting and counter evidence and permits active/paused/resolved/retired/saturated lifecycle states.
primary_evidence.budget_control: The official exploration strategist explicitly combines Level-1 frontier state with Level-2 investigation resolution, remaining uncertainties and experiment budget to choose among create, attach, deepen, switch, retire and stop actions. Thus a weakened or unresolved claim can consume another discriminating experiment, while resolved/artifact-like/low-value investigations can release budget to other frontiers.
primary_evidence.system_scope: The paper evaluates open-ended discovery on 40 real-data tasks across DiscoveryBench, BLADE and BixBench and reports that explicit hypothesis management, local adjudication and frontier control improve evidence-calibrated claim formation over less structured variants.
primary_evidence.control_relevance: This materially advances the belief-revocation frontier: evidence identity and reversible claim status are directly coupled to experiment allocation instead of being merely logged after the fact.
primary_evidence.limits: The implementation is not an immutable event-sourced provenance ledger, and its experiments are dataset-based rather than a physical laboratory. Confidence calibration includes heuristic LLM judging, so a physical/source-qualified replication remains open.

candidate_086.name: multi-hypothesis failure attribution with intervention-level routing
candidate_086.mechanism_hypothesis: When a research attempt fails, do not run one generic reflection pass. Generate multiple evidence-grounded failure hypotheses from the trajectory, independently assess their severity, verify a root cause, and deterministically route repair to the smallest appropriate intervention level: implementation, experimental design, or scientific hypothesis. Ground final quantitative claims only in measured outputs.

primary_evidence.source: Jie Ma et al., One Reflection Is Not Enough: Self-Correcting Autonomous Research via Multi-Hypothesis Failure Attribution, arXiv:2606.31478v1, 2026-06-30.
primary_evidence.system_result: On a 12-topic, five-domain autonomous-research benchmark, the paper reports that its structured self-correction system raises metrics-bearing outputs from 42% for a reflection baseline to 92%, raises artifact quality from 5.00 to 6.75 out of 10, and obtains a blind overall score of 52.0 versus 48.2 for AI-Scientist-v2. Gains are reported as concentrated in code development and execution.
primary_evidence.mechanism: The method packages structured failure context, generates multiple possible explanations, evaluates severity, verifies the root cause and uses deterministic intervention-level routing rather than treating every failure as a prompt for undirected reflection. Reporting is separately grounded against measured values.
primary_evidence.control_relevance: This is the strongest direct evidence in the current clean frontier that generic reflection should be replaced by explicit failure attribution plus typed repair routing. It complements candidate_084: AutoLabs shows defect-type dependence in chemistry, while this work supplies a system-level reflection-baseline comparison in automated research.
primary_evidence.limits: The benchmark is automated computational research rather than a wet or physical lab. The reported system effect combines multi-hypothesis failure attribution with grounded reporting, so the causal contribution of the attribution module alone still needs isolation.

process_epistemic_boundary.source: Martino Rios-Garcia et al., AI scientists produce results without reasoning scientifically, arXiv:2604.18805v1, 2026-04-20.
process_epistemic_boundary.primary_result: Across more than 25,000 agent runs spanning eight scientific domains, the paper reports that the base model explains 41.4% of performance variance while scaffold explains 1.5%; agents ignore available evidence in 68% of analyzed traces, perform refutation-driven belief revision in only 26%, and rarely gather convergent evidence from multiple tests.
process_epistemic_boundary.control_implication: Outcome score alone is insufficient to validate candidates_083-086. Future controller comparisons should additionally measure evidence uptake, refutation-driven belief revision, convergent multi-test support and whether a repair actually changes the evidential basis of the claim. This is a process-level stress test rather than a new positive mechanism claim.
